cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll give you the spare key over dinner. Have you booked a table?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I never gave you a spare. Where did it come from?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One arrangement at a time, please. We need a confirmed table before we discuss what happens over it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's confirmed for two. Did my sister give you the key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If we're including your sister, we need three places. Ring the restaurant before you invite anyone else.

reason: A makes the avoided origin question a false scheduling problem; B's completed booking and sister hypothesis cause another correction of dinner planning rather than an answer.
